summary: First-finish smoke test for Utrerapp MVP. Backend endpoints (traffic, pharmacies, theater, transit, events, news, tv), admin auth flow, protected CRUD on /traffic, chat SSE streaming (Claude Sonnet 4.6) and history persistence all pass. Frontend Home, Conso streaming chat, module pages (Farmacias, Teatro, Transporte, Eventos, UtreraTV, Noticias) and Admin CRUD (login/wrong pw stays, add+delete traffic, logout) all work end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/traffic returns 3 seeded zones (Trianilla, Salesianos, Centro Historico)
POST /api/admin/login admin123 -> 200 with token; wrong pw -> 401
POST /api/traffic without Bearer -> 401; with Bearer -> 200 created; DELETE /api/traffic/{id} -> {deleted:true}
POST /api/chat/stream returns 77 SSE 'data: ' chunks in Spanish and ends with 'data: [DONE]'
GET /api/chat/history/sess-test returns persisted user + assistant messages
Home / renders home-page + traffic-alerts-banner + conso-ai-card + 6 module-card-* testids
Conso streaming shows assistant reply bubble after send (SSE working in browser)
/farmacias shows pharmacy-duty-card, /teatro shows 3 show-item-*, /transporte has tab-bus, /noticias shows 5 news-item-*
Admin: wrong password keeps user on login; admin123 -> admin-panel; add traffic (TestUI) appears in admin-list-traffic; delete removes it; logout returns to login
notes: Traffic model uses fields zone/status/message/detail (not area/title/description/severity as stated in the review request). Backend accepts and validates properly; specs description was slightly inaccurate but implementation is consistent.
